spanish: Si sus dueños con él, no pagará; si jornalero él, viene en su jornal.

findings.issue: Adjective masculine singular ‘hired’ is rendered as the noun ‘jornalero’ (a human day laborer), resolving an open ‘hired’ into a specialized worker.
Qal perfect 3ms (completed ‘came’) is rendered as present ‘viene’, dropping the completed aspect.
‘jornal’ adds a day-wage unit; the token is hire/wages with preposition ‘in’ and a 3ms suffix.

notes: Si sus dueños con él, no pagará matches אם בעליו עמו לא ישלם.
